market.category: Apple Watch calorie and activity trackers
market.audience: iPhone Duo and Apple Watch users who want total calories burned visible during the day without logging food or opening Health
market.problem: Apple Health separates energy details and activity surfaces emphasize movement, so total daily burn is easy to miss at the moment of decision.
market.advantage: Total Calories combines active plus resting energy into one daily number and puts it on the Watch face, widgets, and Lock Screen, free and on-device.
market.competitive_context: The app competes with activity rings and calorie trackers that make users open a phone, log food, create an account, or pay for basic visibility. It wins on total-burn visibility in the surfaces users already check.

proof_points.claim: The Today screen shows total calories against a daily target with steps
History shows 30 days of daily burn with averages and totals
Onboarding states the app reads Apple Health, stays on the device and needs no account

story.throughline: Make total daily burn visible at a glance, over time and privately on the iPhone Duo outer display
